text:
Priya Nair: Flagging two billing adjustments this morning. Token tallies for three customers came through late and invoices were updated after the fact. Need a short RCA and owners for remediations + comms.

Tomás Vega: Which customers & when? I can investigate the pipeline.

Priya Nair: Customers: orbit-data, shopwave, metric-labs. Events delayed between 2026-04-09 22:40 UTC and 2026-04-10 00:05 UTC. Billing adjustments queued: ADJ-9010, ADJ-9011, ADJ-9012. S3 export: s3://redwood-metering/incident-2026-04/artifacts.csv

Kai Huang: I can take the pipeline root cause. Initial hunch: consumer group rebalance during broker rolling upgrade caused partition assignments to stall. I saw broker mgmt events around 22:38 UTC.

billing-bot: Notice: Adjustments queued ADJ-9010 ADJ-9011 ADJ-9012 status=pending

Tomás Vega: Logs: from metering-collector-0:
```
2026-04-09T22:38:12Z WARN consumer CoordinatorNotAvailable - waiting for coordinator
2026-04-09T22:38:14Z ERROR metering-collector consumer rebalance in_progress group=collector-main - partition assignment timeout
```
Repro command I ran: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka1:9092 --describe --group collector-main`

Kai Huang: Short-term mitigation: pin critical metering topics to separate consumer group with `session.timeout.ms` tuned and enable cooperative-sticky assignment to reduce full rebalance duration. I can test in staging.

Priya Nair: I'll own customer-facing notes and confirm credits posted. Draft: "We observed a temporary delay in processing usage data due to an internal consumer rebalance. Token counts were corrected and credits applied (see ADJ IDs). We're changing ingest config and adding monitoring to prevent recurrence." Any legal needed?

Tomás Vega: Legal not necessary for standard credits, but loop in support if customers escalate. Also add SLO change: set metering ingestion 99th pct <= 2m.

Kai Huang: Proposed alert:
```
alert: MeteringIngestDelay
expr: increase(metering_events_delayed[5m]) > 0 and sum(kafka_consumer_lag{group="collector-main"}) > 2000
for: 3m
annotations:
  summary: "Metering ingest delay detected"
  runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-ingest-delay"
```
I'll open PR to Alertmanager.

Priya Nair: Timeline suggestion:
- Kai: full RCA + config PR by 2026-04-14
- Tomás: alerts + SLO update by 2026-04-13
- Priya: customer emails + adjustments applied by 2026-04-12 (before next invoice run)
- Writeup in postmortem tracker by 2026-04-16

billing-bot: Adjustments processed: ADJ-9010 status=completed 2026-04-10T09:21:11Z, ADJ-9011 status=completed 2026-04-10T09:21:13Z, ADJ-9012 status=completed 2026-04-10T09:21:14Z

Tomás Vega: I've run a historical scan to check recurrence: SQL I used:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at) as day, count(*) as delayed_count
FROM metering.events
WHERE processed_at - ingested_at > interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
Prelim shows 3 similar spikes in the last 90 days, one of which lines up with a broker maintenance window.

Kai Huang: Action items (adding owners):
1) RCA + config change (owner: Kai Huang) - due 2026-04-14
2) Alert + dashboard + SLO update (owner: Tomás Vega) - due 2026-04-13
3) Invoice adjustments & customer outreach (owner: Priya Nair) - due 2026-04-12
4) Postmortem doc + attach artifacts (owner: Kai Huang + Tomás Vega) - due 2026-04-16

Priya Nair: I've created PM-812 in tracker and linked S3 export. Please attach logs and SQL results.

Tomás Vega: Scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow to walk through logs. If we decide to change consumer group settings, we'll roll during next quiet window. :eyes:

Priya Nair: Thanks team. I'll paste the email template after sending. Keep thread updated if customers reply.
